segments.name: Agreement Management
segments.description: Provides agreement management software, e-signature and contract lifecycle management to businesses of all sizes worldwide, from global enterprises to very small businesses.
segments.evidence: Docusign's core offerings — our Intelligent Agreement Management ("IAM") platform, the world's leading e-signature solution, and contract lifecycle management ("CLM") solution — allow organizations to boost productivity, accelerate contract review cycles, and transform agreement data into insights and actions, while providing a customer-centric experience.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscription fees, generally under multi-year contracts, to access the software platform and related support, with some deployment and integration services.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue primarily from sales of subscriptions to access our software platform and related subscriptions of our customers.
